purpose: Pinned source-built GNU Autotools fallback for native hosts whose standard image lacks the build tools required by mg's reviewed autogen.sh.
activation: Use only when any of autoreconf, autoconf, automake, aclocal, autoheader or m4 is missing from the runner PATH.

dependencies.name: GNU M4
dependencies.reason: Autoconf requires GNU M4; build it first into the owned prefix.

dependencies.name: GNU Autoconf
dependencies.reason: Provides autoreconf, autoconf and autoheader required by the pinned mg autogen.sh.

dependencies.name: GNU Automake
dependencies.published_sha256_discrepancy: The GNU release announcement lists 7a658b0e322d75d841e3b7b1b92f8061c5ad947207f8919dec5f9361be4c21bc for this .xz archive, but the archive served by the official GNU HTTPS URL hashes to 168aa363278351b89af56684448f525a5bce5079d0b6842bd910fdd3f1646887 and has a valid detached signature from the listed GNU release key. The build pins the hash of the signature-verified bytes.
dependencies.reason: Provides automake and aclocal required by the pinned mg source.

safety: Each official GNU HTTPS archive is checked against its frozen SHA-256 before safe bounded xz-tar extraction. The source archives and detached signatures were read back locally; gpgv verified each with the corresponding public key in the official GNU keyring.
No package manager, global prefix, shell profile, registry, or system package database is modified.
Configure, make and install run with HOME, temp, build and prefix confined to the active mg target; process groups, output and total wall time are bounded.
Only toolchain provenance, source archives and command logs are uploaded; installed toolchain binaries are not retained in the campaign packet.
scope: Dependency inputs for the mg source build only; these packages do not become Playtestr production dependencies or new project admissions.
